# dockercompose_project (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    dockercompose = {
      source  = "xRizur/dockercompose"
      version = "~> 1.2"
    }
  }
}

# Single provider, multiple nodes driven by a YAML file
locals {
  nodes = yamldecode(file("nodes.yaml"))
  all_projects = {
    for pair in flatten([
      for node_name, node in local.nodes : [
        for project_name, project in node.projects : {
          key          = "${node_name}/${project_name}"
          host         = node.host
          project_name = project_name
        }
      ]
    ]) : pair.key => pair
  }
}

resource "dockercompose_project" "services" {
  for_each = local.all_projects

  name = each.value.project_name
  host = each.value.host   # ssh://agent@10.0.0.x — per-resource, no provider aliases needed

  compose_yaml = file("${each.value.project_name}/docker-compose.yml")
}

# Using ssh_connection block instead of a plain URL
resource "dockercompose_project" "app" {
  name = "backend-services"

  ssh_connection {
    host = "10.0.0.5"
    user = "deploy"
    port = 22
  }

  compose_file = "/var/app/backend-services/docker-compose.yml"
  remove_volumes_on_destroy = true
}

# Inline YAML, provider-level host
resource "dockercompose_project" "yaml_app" {
  name = "inline-services"

  compose_yaml = <<-EOT
    services:
      web:
        image: nginx:latest
        ports:
          - "80:80"
  EOT

  remove_volumes_on_destroy = true
}
```

## Import

```shell
# Using provider-level host
terraform import dockercompose_project.app backend-services

# Using resource-level host (full Docker host URL required)
terraform import dockercompose_project.app ssh://deploy@10.0.0.5/backend-services
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name for the Docker Compose stack.

### Optional

- `compose_file` (String) Path to an existing docker-compose.yml file.
- `compose_yaml` (String) Inline docker-compose YAML content. Supports templatefile().
- `host` (String) Full Docker daemon host URL (e.g. `ssh://agent@10.0.0.1`). Overrides the provider-level host for this resource. Conflicts with `ssh_connection`.
- `remove_volumes_on_destroy` (Boolean) Whether to remove volumes on destroy.
- `ssh_connection` (Block, max 1) SSH connection parameters used to build the Docker host URL. Authentication uses the system SSH agent. Conflicts with `host`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--ssh_connection))

### Read-Only

- `container` (List of Object) Runtime information about containers in the stack (populated after apply). Sorted by service name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--container))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `yaml_sha256` (String) SHA256 hash of the compose YAML for change detection.
